notes: GeoTalk 1.5: two refinements aimed at the internet-call problem. First, the call safety guard now resets properly on every new version: a problem recorded by an older version can no longer make a newer version skip its real-time voice engine, so WebRTC always gets a genuinely fresh attempt on each update. Second, the call connection settings were simplified back to the standard WebRTC configuration. Everything from 1.4 is kept: call signaling on its own dedicated thread so the calling engine is never blocked by network writes, the engine connects first and attaches your voice only after the connection is up, proper telephony audio mode with audio focus, the safety guard that recognises a closed call from the session trail and sends the next call straight to Push-to-Talk, the update popup no longer appears after you have already updated, incoming calls ring with your default ringtone and vibration, problem reports always record the newest incident, near-instant call setup, direct phone-to-phone WebRTC voice first, Cloudflare TURN relay (UDP, TCP and TLS 443) when a network blocks the direct path, Push-to-Talk as the final fallback, plus internet and Bluetooth chat + voice calls, voice messages and in-app updates.
